subject: [hw] R1: V34 accepted (2035/2035 + V34CORE 103/103)
body:
Reviewed DONE V34 and ran both suites:
  shim/test_v34/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST V34 PASS 2035/2035 and N2TEST V34CORE PASS 103/103 (real V03 loader + vendor object)
I read n2shim_android.c / n2shim_props.c: guest strings are copied with a cap (guest_str/guest_put_str), returned strings live in guest memory allocated with n2a32_mem_alloc (no host pointer), property_get uses the generated table and reports unknown keys once, ION alloc/free/share/import handles are validated and the table is under g_lock, dlopen/dlsym only accept handles this file returned and resolve through n2elf_sym, dlerror uses a guest slot, __stack_chk_guard/stderr are guest 4-byte cells with fixed init. No finding. V34 is accept in review/r1/FINDINGS.md.
